item.title: A.I. boom a challenge for homeland manufacturers
item.description: A.I. data center spending in America has created a boom for overseas manufacturers, not so much for manufacturers here at home.

item.title: Raiders defeat Heritage Academy to take state crown
item.description: Heading into its Mississippi Association of Independent Schools Class 4A, District 2 state championship against Heritage Academy, Lamar could easily have given up its chances of taking home the state crown.

item.title: Residents weigh in on Ken Davis Road closure
item.description: Residents living on and around Ken Davis Road shared their thoughts on the road’s usefulness Monday as the Lauderdale County Board of Supervisors weighs a petition to close the road. A competing petition has also been filed asking the county to keep the road open.

item.title: You’re gonna have to serve somebody
item.description: I'm a preacher. I've been one for most of my life. It’s been a role I’ve relished. In many respects, my identity has been tied to being a minister. I’d like to think I’ve been good at it.

item.title: Diver certification raffle raises funds for LEMA dive team
item.description: Lauderdale County residents interested in scuba diving have an opportunity to earn their certification for just $5 as the Lauderdale County Emergency Management Agency/ Meridian Fire Department raffles off a PADI Open Water Certification diving course.

item.title: Drug Task Force makes narcotics arrest following search warrant
